messages:
lucas_billing: FYI daily billing job flagged a 12.6k USD surge tied to job=job-9f7b in two zones. Vendor invoice lines show identical compute_image_id but separate zone postings. Anyone available to triage?

neha_prod: ugh. was that the nightly index build? that job should be pinned to europe-west1 only. @derek_infra can the scheduler have drifted?
derek_infra: scheduler has strict-region affinity for that queue. will check allocator and instance logs.

billing-bot: Alert: billing-anomaly job=job-9f7b amount_delta=+12,620 USD window=2026-03-25T01:00Z..2026-03-25T04:00Z ticket=BILL-247102

sara_ops: vendor support responded: "We see image IMG-af12 referenced in us-central1 and europe-west1 within the window. Preliminary reconciliation shows two separate instance_ids but same image fingerprint. Requesting mapping file for audit."

lucas_billing: I ran a quick group_by on our internal usage table: 

```
SELECT job_id, region, SUM(cost_usd) FROM usage_lines
WHERE job_id = 'job-9f7b' GROUP BY job_id, region;
-- results:
-- job-9f7b | europe-west1 | 7020.00
-- job-9f7b | us-central1 | 5600.00
```

neha_prod: hmm. We merged a new prefetcher sidecar in last week that has a fallback to a shared prefetch cluster in us-central for throughput bursts. That could explain spawn in us-central1. I thought that was gated though.
derek_infra: digging into allocation logs. Found this trace: 

```
2026-03-25T01:14:08Z job=job-9f7b allocator=alloc-v2 decision=spillover_to_shared_pool reason=cpu_wait_timeout
instance=request-cc3 image=IMG-af12 target_region=us-central1
```

neha_prod: ok that's the culprit. The sidecar's backoff logic triggers a spillover to a multi-region shared pool if local prefetchers are saturated. That pool runs in multiple regions for latency; unfortunately vendor bills per region instance create.

sara_ops: vendor asked for a CSV mapping instance_id,region,start_ts,end_ts and wants it within 6 hours for a formal audit. @derek_infra can you export from the allocator?
derek_infra: exporting now. Will scrub internal IPs. Uploading to /secure-shared/billing/correlations/job-9f7b-247102.csv and granting finance+ops. Sample: 

```
instance_id,region,start_ts,end_ts
REQ-cc3,us-central1,2026-03-25T01:14:07Z,2026-03-25T01:43:12Z
REQ-d4f,us-central1,2026-03-25T01:30:02Z,2026-03-25T02:02:19Z
REQ-b70,europe-west1,2026-03-25T01:10:00Z,2026-03-25T01:52:00Z
```

lucas_billing: thanks. Finance note: if vendor refuses credit, we'll run a retro allocation to the infra budget since this is clearly a runtime spillover configuration. Need confirmation from infra + product today for ledger entry.

neha_prod: I'll open a PR to disable automatic spillover for high-cost job classes and add an explicit opt-in for shared-pool. PR: github.com/redwood/prefetcher/PR/462

derek_infra: also raising a change to tagging: ensure instances spawned by spillover carry `origin=shared-pool` tag so vendor reconciliation can key off it. PR: github.com/redwood/infra/PR/901

billing-bot: Added checklist to BILL-247102: [ ] correlation CSV uploaded, [ ] product opt-out PR, [ ] infra tagging PR. Owner=derek_infra due=2026-03-25T18:00Z

sara_ops: vendor acknowledged receipt and requested the full audit logs for the pool between 2026-03-25T01:00Z..2026-03-25T04:00Z. They said if audit shows legitimate multi-zone runs we'll still accept a credit for duplicate image grouping.

lucas_billing: Good. Finance will hold off invoice adjustments until vendor confirms. If credit denied we'll post a retro allocation to infra and notify cost-center owners. Pinning thread for audit notes. :white_check_mark:
